The '''Cog Hive Seven system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as [[Cog Hive Seven]].
